title: Reorder-point exceptions report
objective: Flag lines below reorder point with IF, then count them, find their share and total their value with COUNTIF, COUNT, COUNTIFS and SUMIFS.
instructions: The stock list is in A1:F11. In E2:E11, show "Yes" when Pairs in stock (column C) is below the Reorder point (column D) on the same row, otherwise "No" (use IF). Then complete the report in H2:H6: H2 counts the lines flagged "Yes" (COUNTIF); H3 counts the lines in total (COUNT on column C); H4 is the share of lines below reorder point as a decimal, H2 divided by H3 (for example 0.25, not 25%); H5 counts the Nairobi lines flagged "Yes" (COUNTIFS); H6 adds the Stock value (K) in column F of the lines flagged "Yes" (SUMIFS). Use $ signs on the list ranges in H2:H6.

starter.G4: Share of lines below reorder point
starter.G6: Stock value of lines below reorder point (K)

hints: For E2 use =IF(C2<D2,"Yes","No") and copy it down to E11. A line exactly on its reorder point is not below it.
H2 is =COUNTIF($E$2:$E$11,"Yes"). H3 is =COUNT($C$2:$C$11). H4 divides H2 by H3.
H5 needs two conditions: region Nairobi in $B$2:$B$11 and "Yes" in $E$2:$E$11. H6 adds $F$2:$F$11 where $E$2:$E$11 is "Yes".
